title: PostgreSQL DBA
creator: roadmap.sh (Official)
description: Step by step guide to becoming a modern PostgreSQL DB Administrator in @currentYear@

steps.title: Relational Database Fundamentals & Concepts
steps.subtitle: RDBMS Core, ACID, MVCC & Relational Model
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering Relational Database Fundamentals & Concepts. Study key concepts: What are Relational Databases?, RDBMS Benefits and Limitations, PostgreSQL vs NoSQL Databases, PostgreSQL vs Other RDBMS.
topics: Basic RDBMS Concepts (Databases, Schemas, Tables, Columns, Rows)

submodules.name: Basic RDBMS Concepts (Databases, Schemas, Tables, Columns, Rows)

steps.title: PostgreSQL Architecture & Storage Internals
steps.subtitle: Process Model, Shared Buffers, WAL & Heap Files
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering PostgreSQL Architecture & Storage Internals. Study key concepts: PostgreSQL Process Architecture (Postmaster, Writer, Checkpointer), Shared Buffers Memory Architecture, Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) & WAL Writer, Heap Storage Pages & Tuples.

steps.title: SQL Execution & Advanced Queries
steps.subtitle: DDL, DML, Window Functions, CTEs & JSONB
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering SQL Execution & Advanced Queries. Study key concepts: Data Definition Language (DDL) & Integrity Constraints, Data Manipulation Language (DML) & Complex Joins, Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK), Common Table Expressions (CTEs) & Recursive Queries.

steps.title: Query Optimization & Performance Tuning
steps.subtitle: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, Indexing & Work Memory
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering Query Optimization & Performance Tuning. Study key concepts: EXPLAIN & EXPLAIN ANALYZE Execution Plans, B-Tree Indexes & Primary Keys, GIN & GiST Indexes for Search/JSONB, Partial Indexes & Expression Indexes.

steps.title: Maintenance & Autovacuum Management
steps.subtitle: Vacuuming, Bloat Cleanup & Statistics
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering Maintenance & Autovacuum Management. Study key concepts: VACUUM & VACUUM FULL Operations, Autovacuum Configuration & Tuning, Transaction ID (XID) Wraparound Prevention, Database & Index Bloat Management.

steps.title: High Availability, Replication & Connection Pooling
steps.subtitle: Streaming Replication, PgBouncer & Failover
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering High Availability, Replication & Connection Pooling. Study key concepts: Physical Streaming Replication (Primary / Standby), Logical Replication & Pub/Sub Model, PgBouncer Connection Pooling (Session vs Transaction Mode), High Availability & Automated Failover (Patroni / Stolon).
topics: PgBouncer Connection Pooling (Session vs Transaction Mode)

submodules.name: PgBouncer Connection Pooling (Session vs Transaction Mode)

steps.title: Backup, Point-In-Time Recovery & Security
steps.subtitle: pg_basebackup, PITR, pg_hba.conf & RBAC
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering Backup, Point-In-Time Recovery & Security. Study key concepts: Physical Backups (pg_basebackup, WAL-G, pgBackRest), Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR) Execution Drill, Client Authentication (pg_hba.conf & SSL/TLS), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Column Encryption.

steps.title: Database Monitoring, Alerting & Operations
steps.subtitle: pg_stat_statements, Prometheus & Grafana
steps.description: Comprehensive module covering Database Monitoring, Alerting & Operations. Study key concepts: Query Performance Tracking (pg_stat_statements), Locks, Deadlocks & Lock Monitoring (pg_locks), Prometheus PostgreSQL Exporter Integration, Grafana Dashboards for DB Metrics & Alerting.
topics: Grafana Dashboards for DB Metrics & Alerting

submodules.name: Grafana Dashboards for DB Metrics & Alerting
